title: The Copper Orchard
author: Odile Nystrom
blurb: Wren Eastwick, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
